d: Sennheiser EW-DX MKE 2 / 835-S Set (R1-9) Digital wireless lavalier/handheld set This combo set consists of 1 x EW-DX SKM-S (handheld with mute switch), 1 x MMD 835 capsule (cardioid, dynamic), 1 x EW-DX SK (wireless bodypack transmitter), 1 x MKE 2 (omni-directional clip-on lavalier microphone), 1 x EW-DX EM 2 rackmout receiver (2 channels) and 2 x BA 70 rechargeable batteries.
